4.sql:
-- Match the exact booster-version label specified in the assignment.
SELECT AVG(PAYLOAD_MASS__KG_) AS Average_Payload_Mass_KG
FROM SPACEXTABLE
WHERE Booster_Version = 'F9 v1.1';

6.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(Booster_Version) AS Booster_Version
FROM SPACEXTABLE
WHERE TRIM(Landing_Outcome) = 'Success (drone ship)'
  AND PAYLOAD_MASS__KG_ > 4000
  AND PAYLOAD_MASS__KG_ < 6000
ORDER BY Booster_Version;

7.sql:
-- Count mission outcomes, which are distinct from booster landing outcomes.
-- Include "Success (payload status unclear)" in the success category.
SELECT CASE
           WHEN TRIM(Mission_Outcome) LIKE 'Success%' THEN 'Success'
           WHEN TRIM(Mission_Outcome) LIKE 'Failure%' THEN 'Failure'
           ELSE 'Other'
       END AS Mission_Result,
       COUNT(*) AS Total_Missions
FROM SPACEXTABLE
GROUP BY Mission_Result
ORDER BY Total_Missions DESC;

8.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(Booster_Version) AS Booster_Version,
       PAYLOAD_MASS__KG_
FROM SPACEXTABLE
WHERE PAYLOAD_MASS__KG_ = (
    SELECT MAX(PAYLOAD_MASS__KG_)
    FROM SPACEXTABLE
)
ORDER BY Booster_Version;

9.sql:
SELECT CASE SUBSTR(Date, 6, 2)
           WHEN '01' THEN 'January'
           WHEN '02' THEN 'February'
           WHEN '03' THEN 'March'
           WHEN '04' THEN 'April'
           WHEN '05' THEN 'May'
           WHEN '06' THEN 'June'
           WHEN '07' THEN 'July'
           WHEN '08' THEN 'August'
           WHEN '09' THEN 'September'
           WHEN '10' THEN 'October'
           WHEN '11' THEN 'November'
           WHEN '12' THEN 'December'
       END AS Month,
       Landing_Outcome,
       TRIM(Booster_Version) AS Booster_Version,
       Launch_Site
FROM SPACEXTABLE
WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2015'
  AND TRIM(Landing_Outcome) = 'Failure (drone ship)'
ORDER BY Date;

10.sql:
SELECT TRIM(Landing_Outcome) AS Landing_Outcome,
       COUNT(*) AS Outcome_Count
FROM SPACEXTABLE
WHERE Date BETWEEN '2010-06-04' AND '2017-03-20'
GROUP BY TRIM(Landing_Outcome)
ORDER BY Outcome_Count DESC, Landing_Outcome;
